modelObjects.name: ChopChopMol 2.0
modelObjects.caption: Web-based 3D molecular visualization & AI-powered editing platform
modelObjects.description: Visualize molecular structures in Three.js, then manipulate them via natural-language commands powered by Claude/GPT, with MACE ML potentials and PySCF/GPU4PySCF DFT for energy and geometry calculations.

modelObjects.name: Researcher / End User
modelObjects.caption: Chemist or researcher visualizing and editing molecules
modelObjects.description: Loads structures, issues natural-language edit/compute commands, views energies and orbitals.

modelObjects.name: Admin
modelObjects.caption: Reviews early-access requests and manages billing
modelObjects.description: Uses the admin queue page to approve/reject access requests.

modelObjects.name: ChopChopMol Frontend
modelObjects.caption: Vanilla HTML/JS single-page app (no build step, ES6 modules, Three.js)
modelObjects.description: Static site deployed to Firebase Hosting / AWS. Renders molecules with Three.js InstancedMesh, hosts the AI chat UI, file explorer, and all client-side molecule editing and compute-client logic.

modelObjects.name: ChopChopMol AI Backend
modelObjects.caption: Python Flask server (separate repo: chopchopmol-ai-backend)
modelObjects.description: Proxies Claude/OpenAI chat over SSE, runs MACE ML-potential and PySCF/GPU4PySCF DFT calculations, executes sandboxed Python, fine-tunes MACE models, and proxies SSH/SFTP. Deploys to Render.com and RunPod GPU.
